notes: Version 3.6 corrects the description of Axiom A3 of the Foundation paper in the statement of hypothesis H-ext and its remarks: A3 is not a non-factorisability axiom. The Foundation paper obtains non-factorisability of the admissible fibre only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived (Foundation version 2.6, Lemma 5.6). The admissible coherence extensivity H-ext remains an explicit open hypothesis, distinct from that reading and not implied by it. No theorem, hypothesis or result of the paper is changed.
